narrative.scqa_md:
First United Bank is a $16.3B in assets regional bank regulated by NCUA, operating since 1951 with 1,001 employees. A 3.4% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as stable give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-001, E-003]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.6/5. The deepest capability gap is ESG Strategy at 1.4/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-015]. Next is Target Architecture Vision at 1.8/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-016, E-200].

Third is Stage-Gate Funding at 1.8/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-202]. The issue register adds PUBLIC evidence mode — 415 of 698 subcaps have NO_EVIDENCE. Coverage ceiling for public assessment of private bank. (critical severity). The issue register adds Mixed mobile app reviews; not BBB accredited; WalletHub/BBB complaints about mortgage forbearance practices and customer service (high severity).

Counter-signal: Case Management & Resolution already runs at 3.3/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The question for First United Bank is whether to close ESG Strategy first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. First United Bank should lead with Databricks (68/100 fit) against Digital Strategy Document, then sequence nCino behind it. Closing ESG Strategy to the peer median alone is worth 1.1 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. The analyst's own priority framing: "No CDO or Formal Data Governance — Exhaustive 10-tier search found no Chief Data Officer, no data governance committee, no BCBS 239 references despite Snowflake, Tableau…".
